$comment: PDIG canonical Chinese copy. Three platforms MUST use these strings for the listed keys so user-facing wording cannot drift. Platforms may localise layout/typography but not the meaning. Extracted from app/theme/tokens.uts and app/services/rules.uts @ 7bc0ed3. Hardcoding copy inline in platform UI is forbidden - UI copy must come from resource files (i18n-ready). v0.3.0 additions are marked keys (relationsV030 / findings / failureDomain / recoveryCycle / changePlanV030 / providerPolicy / scenarioV030) and are additive.
hardRules: Normal UI MUST NOT display engineering enums (GraphRevision, DependencyProposal, RealityDrift, ScenarioCoverage, SourceInstance, merchant_agreement, funding_source, criticality, SHARED_FAILURE_DOMAIN, RECOVERY_CYCLE, FD-003).
Readiness MUST NEVER be expressed as safe / fully safe / 100% / all clear.
